wstep: There is no recipe here for pork luncheon meat, a dense, packed mass of ground pork with curing salt, canned in jars (Polish mielonka).

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
Do not attempt to can pureed vegetables, red meats or poultry at home: proper processing times for pureed foods have not been determined for home use.
Tyndallization (repeated heating with pauses for spores to germinate) is not considered fully reliable, because some superdormant spores do not germinate between heatings.

akapity: Botulinum spores are very hard to destroy at boiling-water temperatures.
